cells.desc: Cloud Daisy sprout
Cloud Daisy growing, closed white bud
Cloud Daisy in full bloom: three daisy heads with fluffy creamy-white petals shaped like little clouds, soft sky-blue petal tips, golden centre
Cloud Daisy wilted
Cloud Dandelion sprout with jagged dandelion leaves
Cloud Dandelion growing, closed yellow bud
Cloud Dandelion ripe: two round fluffy puffballs in warm pale yellow, soft like tiny clouds, on slim stems
Cloud Dandelion wilted, puffballs half blown away
Rainbow Rose sprout with small rose leaves
Rainbow Rose growing, closed pink bud
Rainbow Rose in full bloom: one big rose whose petals shade softly from pink outside to peach, butter yellow, mint and lilac in the centre (pastel, not neon)
Rainbow Rose wilted
Star Orchid sprout with two broad orchid leaves
Star Orchid growing, arching stem with violet buds
Star Orchid in full bloom: an arching stem with two violet orchid flowers whose five petals form a rounded five-point star, small golden dot in each centre
Star Orchid wilted
Moon Lily sprout with long thin lily leaves
Moon Lily growing, long closed pale bud
Moon Lily in full bloom: two trumpet lilies in pale silvery blue and moonlight cream, petal tips curling like small crescent moons
Moon Lily wilted
Dream Bell sprout with round leaves
Dream Bell growing, arched stem with small green bell buds
Dream Bell in full bloom: an arched stem with three hanging bell flowers in periwinkle blue with lighter rims
Dream Bell wilted
